injections.name: the regions are three rectangles with hard edges
failed: a region boundary is a blend, not a line: the two weathers are half and half where they meet
rain thins out across a boundary instead of stopping at it

injections.name: the blend is a straight ramp, and creases at each end of the band
failed: the blend between regions has no crease in it

injections.name: a norther brings rain and a flat grey sky, as the popular image has it
failed: a norther is a wind and a cold clear sky, and it brings no rain of its own

injections.name: the wind blows the way it came from, so a norther drives things back up to the north
failed: a norther is a wind and a cold clear sky, and it brings no rain of its own

injections.name: a day flicks on at its first minute instead of coming up over an hour and a half

injections.name: the fog hangs about all afternoon instead of burning off by nine
failed: the fog burns off by the hour the record says, and never comes back in the afternoon

injections.name: the clock past midnight is read as a running total, so the thirtieth morning is an afternoon
failed: the fog burns off by the hour the record says, and never comes back in the afternoon

injections.name: the fog can be drawn to opacity, and hides what a student is entitled to see
